messages:
anya: publishbot tried to promote image to staging but deploy-bot blocked it due to provenance timestamp outside TTL :hourglass:
deploy-bot: blocked digest sha256:5a1f...9d00 - provenance.cosign_kms_ts=2024-10-28T01:02:00Z (grace=24h)
matt: saw the alert. EU mirror key rotated last night, attestations stamped older time. low-risk path: pin to last-known-good digest and republish
anya: plan: lock staging for 10m, pin services to sha256:0f3c...ab12, ops republish to staging-temp with fresh cosign attestation, then promote and unpin after checks
ops-bot: created ticket RB-5207 and attached label provenance-resync
sree: I'll take the republish. pushing to staging-temp and will cosign with mirror KMS. will add label provenance.resynced_by=sree
(90s)
sree: push done -> new digest sha256:7b9e...c4ff, cosign kms_ts=2024-11-09T06:30:00Z. uploading provenance metadata now
deploy-bot: promote from staging-temp to staging succeeded, smoke tests green :white_check_mark:
anya: unpin after 2m observation and update release notes: "hotfix: pinned staging to sha256:0f3c...ab12 during provenance resync; new image sha256:7b9e...c4ff promoted after resync (RB-5207)"
matt: follow-up ORG-2422: add alert for mirror attestations older than 18h after rotation and shorten grace window for mirrored regions
anya: thanks all, closing when RB-5207 and release notes updated :thumbsup:
